services.desc: for those just traveling through or making their home in Chattanooga and are needing a long-term solution. Our barn has six stalls with fresh straw and a window to the fresh air outside. There is also a washing pad with hose access to rinse your horse off, brush, and refill water. For our travelers- if you don’y have an RV or accommodations in your trailer, we offer to you an overnight stay in one of our three tiny homes. Wake up with the sun, load your horse, and head back on the road.
